          : (playerAnswer
            ? `（${charName} 认真看完了你的回答，眼里满是温柔...）`
            : `（${charName} 轻轻戳了戳你：下次可不许跳过了哦～）`);
      } catch (e) {
        replyText = playerAnswer
          ? `（${charName} 被你的回答感动了，一时不知道说什么好...）`
          : `（${charName} 笑着摇了摇头：害羞鬼～）`;
      }

      removeTypingIndicator();
      await addAiBubblesSequentially(replyText);
      show(el('post-actions'), true);
    }

    // 分享结果
    async function shareGameResult() {
      // 保存当前状态以便恢复
      const savedView = currentView;

      if (!window.Nuojiji) {
        toast('请在 App 内使用分享功能');
        return;
      }

      const chosenText = el('chosen-text')?.textContent || '';
      const chatBubbles = el('chat-area')?.querySelectorAll('.chat-msg.left .chat-bubble') || [];
      const replyText = Array.from(chatBubbles).map(b => b.textContent).join(' ') || '';

      const shareData = {
        title: '真心话大冒险 💕',
        summary: `${userName} 和 ${charName} 的恋人牌局\n\n🃏 ${chosenText}\n\n💌 ${charName}：${replyText}`,
        accentColor: '#e8a4b8',
        badge: '💕 恋人挑战',
        footer: '真心话大冒险 · 恋人牌局'
      };

      try {
        if (typeof Nuojiji.shareResult === 'function') {
          await Nuojiji.shareResult(shareData);
          toast('分享成功 💕');
        } else if (typeof Nuojiji.share === 'function') {
          await Nuojiji.share(shareData);
          toast('分享成功 💕');
        } else {
          toast('分享功能不可用');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        toast('分享已取消');
      }

      // 分享完成后强制恢复页面渲染
      setTimeout(() => {
        currentView = savedView;
        forceRepaint();
      }, 300);
    }

    // 温和重绘页面（解决分享后白屏问题）
    function forceRepaint() {
      // 确保当前视图可见
      Object.values(views).forEach(id => el(id).classList.remove('active'));
      el(views[currentView]).classList.add('active');
      if (currentView === 'play') {
        show(el('post-actions'), true);
      }
      // 1) 临时移除 backdrop-filter 避免 WebView 合成层丢失
      const blurEls = document.querySelectorAll('.card, .header, .toast, .modal-card, .player-answer-area, .typing-status');
      blurEls.forEach(e => { e.style.backdropFilter = 'none'; e.style.webkitBackdropFilter = 'none'; });
      // 2) 轻量级重绘，避免display:none导致白屏
      document.body.style.opacity = '0.99';
      void document.body.offsetHeight;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { document.body.style.opacity = ''; });
      // 3) 滚动归位
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      el('ui').scrollTop = 0;
      // 4) 下一帧恢复 backdrop-filter
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          blurEls.forEach(e => { e.style.backdropFilter = ''; e.style.webkitBackdropFilter = ''; });
        });
      });
    }

    // 防抖：避免多个事件同时触发 forceRepaint
    let _repaintTimer = null;
    function debouncedRepaint() {
      if (_repaintTimer) clearTimeout(_repaintTimer);
      _repaintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        _repaintTimer = null;
        forceRepaint();
      }, 150);
    }

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    // 事件绑定
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════
    // 监听页面可见性变化和恢复事件（防止分享后白屏）
    let _wasHidden = false;
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        _wasHidden = true;
      } else if (_wasHidden) {
        _wasHidden = false;
        debouncedRepaint();
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', (e) => {
      if (e.persisted) debouncedRepaint();
    });
    // 移除 window focus 上的 debouncedRepaint，避免点击输入框时触发黑屏

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadProfile();

      // 日夜间切换
      el('theme-toggle').addEventListener('click', toggleTheme);

      // 角色选择
      el('pick-char').addEventListener('click', pickChar);
      el('skip-char').addEventListener('click', zoneEnter);

      // 区域选择
      document.querySelectorAll('.zone').forEach(z => z.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const target = z.getAttribute('data-zone');
        if (target === '爱欲区') {
          try {
            if (!localStorage.getItem('ageVerified18')) {
              el('age-modal').classList.add('on');
              return;
            }
          } catch (e) {
            // sandbox 下 localStorage 不可用
            el('age-modal').classList.add('on');
            return;
          }
        }
        zone = target;
        decks = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BUILTIN[zone] || []));
        extraDecks = [];
        renderZone();
      }));

      const toggle = el('ai-toggle');
      toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const on = !toggle.classList.contains('on');
        toggle.classList.toggle('on', on);
        toggle.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(on));
        el('gen-ai-decks').disabled = !on;
        el('prompt-preview').classList.toggle('show', on);
        updatePromptPreview();
      });
      el('gen-ai-decks').addEventListener('click', genAiDecks);
      el('zone-next').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!(BUILTIN[zone] || []).length && !extraDecks.length) { toast('题库为空'); return; }
        cameFromPlay = false;
        goto('dice');
      });
      el('zone-back').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (cameFromPlay) {
          cameFromPlay = false;
          goto('dice');
        } else {
          goto('role');
        }
      });

      // 掷骰
      el('roll').addEventListener('click', doRoll);
      el('dice-continue').addEventListener('click', enterPlay);
      el('dice-back').addEventListener('click', () => goto('zone'));

      // 抽卡与执行
      el('char-pick').addEventListener('click', charPickCard);
      el('play-restart').addEventListener('click', () => goto('dice'));
      el('play-restart2').addEventListener('click', () => goto('dice'));
      el('play-zone').addEventListener('click', () => {
        cameFromPlay = true;
        renderZone();
        goto('zone');
      });

      // 后续操作
      el('next-round').addEventListener('click', () => goto('dice'));
      el('share-result').addEventListener('click', shareGameResult);
      el('back-zone').addEventListener('click', () => {
        cameFromPlay = true;
        renderZone();
        goto('zone');
      });

      // 输入框获取焦点时滚动到可见区域（解决键盘遮挡）
      el('answer-textarea').addEventListener('focus', () => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          const area = el('player-answer-area');
          if (area && area.classList.contains('show')) {
            // 使用 block: 'end' 确保输入框底部可见，不被键盘遮挡
            area.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
          }
        }, 400);
      });

      // 监听 visualViewport 变化（iOS键盘弹出）
      if (window.visualViewport) {
        let _vpTimer = null;
        window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          if (_vpTimer) clearTimeout(_vpTimer);
          _vpTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            _vpTimer = null;
            const area = el('player-answer-area');
            if (area && area.classList.contains('show')) {
              // 键盘弹出/收起时，确保输入框底部始终可见
              area.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
              // 额外的安全措施：如果还是看不到，强制滚动到底部
              setTimeout(() => {
                const uiEl = el('ui');
                if (uiEl && area.classList.contains('show')) {
                  const areaRect = area.getBoundingClientRect();
                  const vpHeight = window.visualViewport ? window.visualViewport.height : window.innerHeight;
                  // 如果输入框底部在视口外，强制滚动
                  if (areaRect.bottom > vpHeight || areaRect.top < 0) {
                    area.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
                  }
                }
              }, 150);
            }
          }, 250);
        });
      }

      // 用户回答：提交 & 跳过（添加防重复提交保护）
      el('submit-answer').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const btn = el('submit-answer');
        if (btn.disabled) return; // 防止重复提交
        
        const text = el('answer-textarea').value.trim();
        if (!text) { toast('写点什么再提交吧～'); return; }
        
        // 禁用按钮，防止重复点击
        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = '提交中...';
        
        submitPlayerAnswer(text).finally(() => {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = '提交回答 💕';
        });
      });
      
      el('skip-answer').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const btn = el('skip-answer');
        if (btn.disabled) return;
        
        btn.disabled = true;
        skipPlayerAnswer().finally(() => {
          btn.disabled = false;
        });
      });

      // 声明弹窗
      el('open-help').addEventListener('click', () => el('help-modal').classList.add('on'));
      el('help-close').addEventListener('click', () => el('help-modal').classList.remove('on'));

      // 年龄确认
      let ageVerified = false;
      el('age-ok')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        ageVerified = true;
        try { localStorage.setItem('ageVerified18', '1'); } catch (e) { /* sandbox */ }
        el('age-modal')?.classList.remove('on');
        zone = '爱欲区';
        decks = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BUILTIN[zone] || []));
        extraDecks = [];
        renderZone();
      });
      el('age-cancel')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        el('age-modal')?.classList.remove('on');
        toast('已取消');
      });
    });
  </script>
